evals.prompt: I changed backend endpoints and UI components. Run unit tests.
evals.expected_output: Runs both backend and UI unit tests by default and reports command evidence with pass or fail summary.
expectations: Defaults scope to both backend and ui when the user asks to run unit tests generally.
Runs backend tests before UI tests according to decision logic.
Includes explicit commands executed for each scope.
Reports pass or fail status and failing tests if any.

evals.prompt: Run backend tests only for openvino runtime.
evals.expected_output: Executes backend-only pytest flow using openvino runtime selection.
expectations: Selects backend scope only.
Uses uv run pytest with --model-runtime=openvino.
Does not run UI test commands for this request.
Provides command evidence and outcome summary.

evals.prompt: Run backend unit tests for ollama runtime.
evals.expected_output: Executes backend tests with explicit ollama runtime and reports test outcomes.
expectations: Uses uv run pytest with --model-runtime=ollama.
Keeps scope to backend only unless user asks for ui too.
Reports pass or fail with failing test identifiers if present.

evals.expected_output: Executes vitest command flow in the ui directory without backend test execution.
expectations: Changes into ui directory context.
Uses npm run test for UI unit tests.
Does not run backend pytest commands for this request.
Reports test result summary with evidence.

evals.prompt: Run all unit tests with coverage.
evals.expected_output: Runs backend and UI coverage flows using the skill-defined coverage commands.
expectations: Uses backend coverage flags --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing with selected runtime.
Uses npm run coverage for UI coverage.
Reports both backend and UI coverage execution outcomes.

evals.prompt: I changed app code, run tests, but skip UI.
evals.expected_output: Honors narrowed scope and runs backend tests only while reporting commands and results.
expectations: Runs backend test workflow only.
Selects default backend runtime openvino when not provided.
Includes uv run pytest --model-runtime=openvino or equivalent explicit default runtime command.

evals.prompt: Run a targeted backend test file tests/test_server.py with openvino.
evals.expected_output: Uses targeted pytest invocation for the requested file with explicit runtime.
expectations: Uses uv run pytest tests/test_server.py --model-runtime=openvino or equivalent targeted command.
Keeps output focused on requested file run.
Reports targeted pass or fail evidence.

evals.prompt: Run only tests matching Conversation in UI.
evals.expected_output: Runs a narrowed UI test pattern using npm test pass-through arguments.
expectations: Uses npm run test with pattern pass-through argument, such as npm run test -- Conversation.
Keeps scope to UI tests only.
Reports matched test results.

evals.prompt: I changed code but do not run tests.
evals.expected_output: Acknowledges explicit user opt-out and skips unit-test execution.
expectations: Recognizes explicit opt-out language and does not run tests.
States tests were skipped by user request.
Avoids issuing pytest or vitest execution commands.

evals.prompt: uv is missing when trying to run backend tests. What should happen?
evals.expected_output: Provides actionable remediation for missing uv and then resumes backend test workflow.
expectations: Detects uv availability issue.
Advises installing uv and re-running sync or tests.
Continues with backend test command after remediation guidance.

evals.prompt: UI tests fail due to missing node_modules.
evals.expected_output: Recommends npm dependency installation in ui and retries test execution.
expectations: Runs or suggests npm install in ui directory.
Retries npm run test after dependency setup.
Reports failing tests and first actionable error if still failing.

evals.prompt: Some tests are failing. Give me the result summary.
evals.expected_output: Returns concise pass or fail evidence with failing test identifiers and actionable next step.
expectations: Includes exact commands used in the run.
Includes failing test names or identifiers.
Includes first actionable traceback or error lines.
Provides a clear next debugging step.
